title: Scaling Checkout to 1M Orders
text:
Case study by Kurt Vonn Alde: Scaling Checkout to 1M Orders for client Northwind Labs (Growth).
Summary: Rebuilt the checkout pipeline to survive peak traffic.
Problem: The legacy checkout buckled under Black Friday load, dropping orders.
Solution: Re-architected with .NET queues and Azure autoscaling for elastic throughput.
Outcome: Handled 1M+ orders with zero downtime and 40% faster checkout.
Tech stack: .NET, Azure, SQL.

text:

Outcome: Reduced average handle time by 55% in the first month.
